description:
Staff identity with roles (box office / admin / finance), the event & inventory builder UI, order management console (lookup, refund, exchange, resend, holds).

**Conditions of Success:**
- Role matrix enforced server-side; box-office staff cannot touch settlement
- Organizer builds a sellable event end-to-end in the UI without API calls
- Console handles the full order lifecycle staff-side

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map).

comments.body: COS defined at epic level. Not yet decomposed — US-stories are created when the owner prioritizes this epic (Gate 1), per PRD 'Capability map'.

<!-- sdlc:stage=backlog kind=summary -->
**Scope anchor (owner decision 2026-07-14):** this epic owns the organizer-facing **catalog builder UI** — the screens to author events, series, seasons, festivals and the typed dated-slot kinds (performance / festival_day / operating_day) plus their publish/archive lifecycle — over the catalog API built in **TKT-2** (children TKT-49…TKT-53). TKT-2 deliberately ships API + storefront only ("creation via API only", per the TKT-26 precedent); the builder UI and the staff identity/RBAC it sits behind are consolidated here so the organizer never touches curl. Decomposing TKT-22 must therefore depend on the relevant TKT-2 catalog endpoints being stable, and cover series/season/festival/slot authoring — not just the M1 single-GA-event shape.
